format_notes: Selectable files are 1080x1920 (9:16), H.264 High + AAC LC 48 kHz stereo, 30 fps, moov atom at front (faststart), under 25 MB. Original videos/*.mp4 files remain in place so previously published URLs stay unchanged.
audio_notes: Selectable clips replace the old procedural music with the approved vocal theme audio/petalspire-theme-a.mp3 (SHA-256 b1a8db25bd6ba3eb01ebe136221d72ea7ba1d8db985dc5c1da599bb8f5805570), from 0.000 seconds for the full clip duration. Loudnorm is single-pass I=-16, TP=-1.5, LRA=11, with a 0.35-second fade-out and no fade-in. No transcription or listening tool was available, so this start offset is not a reviewed lyrical excerpt. Silence detection was not treated as evidence of singing. Narrated promo files are excluded: replacing their audio would erase narration, and layering this vocal may compete with speech.

review_limits.visual: An independent review of a local preparation copy of reel-tin-open.mp4, built with this same opening-frame recipe, reported a bright closed sage-tin first frame, a clean opening transition, and no black flashes. The other nine corrected files have not been visually reviewed. This hosted encode is a recreation, not a claim that those reviewed bytes were rechecked.
review_limits.audio: Audio was not heard. No local transcription tool was available. vocal_excerpt_reviewed is false. Do not describe these clips as containing a confirmed lyrical section.
